name: [⚔️] Monster Fight
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Monster Fight 🐾🔥

Not all pets are meant to be found…
Some worlds don’t forgive mistakes 👁️

How to Play:
🐾 Discover and equip animals
🥚 Hatch eggs for rare, shiny & unknown pets
⚔️ Fight monsters, bosses & unseen dangers
💎 Collect loot, coins & gems
🗺️ Explore new worlds with secrets inside

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile (including Tablet) & Console players

🏆 Only the strongest teams survive.
